text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are suffering from chronic diarrhea and lower abdominal discomfort; to help me identify the cause, please tell me how long these symptoms have been occurring and if there has been any blood in your stool or unexplained weight loss.

speaker: Patient
text: 31-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing chronic diarrhea on most days for the past four months. She mentions lower abdominal discomfort and cramping, which is relieved by diarrhea. She went camping several months ago and recalls another member of the camping party falling ill recently.
